responsibility: This file implements mc’s structured semantic error formatter. It parses a custom mini-language embedded in diagnostic templates, extracts names/types/descriptions and declaration/use token locations from decl nodes and nameKey values, creates normal or chained warnings/errors through mcError, and supports token-specific as well as current-token reporting. It is the semantic-diagnostics layer that turns AST and symbol metadata into user-facing error text for the parser passes.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements mcMetaError’s mini-format language, varargs operand decoding, node/name/type expansion, and creation of mcError errors or chained diagnostics. Its sibling mcMetaError.def only defines the callable interface and documents the formatting directives.
